rows.title: Conditional commitment letter: up to $1.5B senior secured delayed-draw term loan from the U.S. Department of War (Office of Strategic Capital)
rows.detail: Conditional commitment letter (not a definitive agreement): up to four tranches - $600 million initial tranche (to refinance in full the first lien senior secured notes due 2030 and pay fees, subject to a Project Undertaking) and $900 million remaining tranches of $200-400 million; expected 30-year maturity and 36-month commitment period; rate expected at the comparable U.S. Treasury rate plus a risk premium provisionally 1.25%-1.75%; subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, congressional authorizations / appropriations, OMB concurrence, equitizing a substantial majority of the convertible notes and offtake letters of intent or agreements.
